assessment: There is abundant evidence for differences in the organization of the visual system between primates and rodents. How do these differences yield distinct behaviors in these species? The authors show a major difference in the ability of mice and primates in detecting figures from ground based on motion and texture patterns, revealing a fundamental limitations of mice in segmenting visual scenes.
